item.title: Bombay HC upholds rejection of interim injunction in ‘Mahalaxmi’ trademark dispute case; imposes ₹10,000/- cost
item.description: The Court opined that a party seeking interim injunction in a passing-off action must produce concrete evidence of use, goodwill, and business turnover. The post Bombay HC upholds rejection of interim injunction in ‘Mahalaxmi’ trademark dispute case; imposes ₹10,000/- cost appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Service Tax not leviable on construction of railway siding for Public Sector Undertaking/Corporations: CESTAT
item.description: “Use of public does not necessarily mean by individual public but also includes use by Public Sector Undertaking/ Corporations” The post Service Tax not leviable on construction of railway siding for Public Sector Undertaking/Corporations: CESTAT appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: RBI Issues 7 Amendment Directions to Enhance Basic Savings Bank Deposit Accounts – December 2025
item.description: On 4-12-2025, the Reserve Bank of India issued 7 amendment directions to improve Basic Savings Bank Deposit accounts. These changes aim to enhance customer service, promote financial inclusion, and align banking services with digitalization. The post RBI Issues 7 Amendment Directions to Enhance Basic Savings Bank Deposit Accounts – December 2025 appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: ‘Present machinery can’t handle traditional cybercrimes, AI/ Deep fake challenges’: Inside Rajasthan High Court’s detailed directions to curb cybercrimes
item.description: In a case pertaining to cyberfraud of Rs. 2,02,00,000 through digital arrest, the High Court issued sweeping directions to Additional Chief Secretary, Home, Director General of Police , Director General, State Crime Record Bureau and Cyber for issuance of necessary notifications, circulars, standard operating procedure etc., to handle the issue of rising cybercrime in State of Rajasthan. The post ‘Present machinery can’t handle traditional cybercrimes, AI/ Deep fake challenges’: Inside Rajasthan

item.title: Kerala High Court’s comprehensive directions for crowd management at Sabarimala during Mandala-Makaravilakku festival
item.description: The directions are to be complied in letter, spirit, and execution, as they are indispensable to regulating the inbound flow of pilgrims and paramount for safeguarding the life, health and safety of every devotee visiting Sannidhanam and the Sanctity of the Holy Temple. The post Kerala High Court’s comprehensive directions for crowd management at Sabarimala during Mandala-Makaravilakku festival appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: RBI Issues 10 Amendment Directions to Enhance Credit Information Reporting Accuracy and Timeliness
item.description: On 4-12-2025, the Reserve Bank of India issued 10 Amendment Directions to strengthen the credit information reporting process. The move aims to ensure more frequent, accurate, and timely submission of credit data by Credit Institutions to Credit Information Companies, thereby improving the quality and recency of reports used in credit underwriting and monitoring. The post RBI Issues 10 Amendment Directions to Enhance Credit Information Reporting Accuracy and Timeliness appeared first on SCC Time

item.title: CRIMINAL LAW ROUNDUP: A quick recap of the top criminal cases from November 2025
item.description: Covering all the important criminal cases across various High Courts and the Supreme Court, this roundup provides a quick summary of cases, links to other roundups, latest legal updates in criminal law and a few top stories of the month. The post CRIMINAL LAW ROUNDUP: A quick recap of the top criminal cases from November 2025 appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Legal heirs of landowners not entitled to project affected persons quota; Future recruitment permitted only if eligibility criteria met: Bombay High Court
item.description: “The petitioner claiming appointment on the basis of grandfather’s land being acquired almost 45 years back and claiming to be a project affected persons was contrary to the advertisement.” The post Legal heirs of landowners not entitled to project affected persons quota; Future recruitment permitted only if eligibility criteria met: Bombay High Court appeared first on SCC Times.
